A tabular diagram (synopsis with braces) in the middle of the page, with German black-letter words. Below the diagram, further running text. Gathering signature at the foot centre-right.

main_text.l: Nihil feceris; falsò creduntur esse Subjunctivi modi:
quia non sunt verba subjungentis, sed imperantis.
Hactenus finita verba, quæ certos numeros ac per-
sonas habent, conjugavimus: Infinita verba, quæ per
se certos numeros ac personas nō habent, sequuntur.
Amare, lieben. Docere, lehren. Legere, lesen. Audire,
Amavisse, geliebet haben. Docuisse, gelehret haben.
Legisse, gelesen haben. Audivisse, gehöret haben. Tu-
lisse, getragen haben. Fuisse, gewesen sein. Voluisse,
Me, te, illum, Nos, vos, illos,
Jam finita & infinita verba cōjugavimus: Sequun-
tur Gerundia & Supina, quæ specie nominalis casus
Amandi, zu lieben / amandum, zu lieben / amando,
Docendi, zu lehren / docendum, zu lehren / docen-

page.notes: The vertical label between the brackets of the diagram (beside the brace under "Amatum" to "Latum") is too small and blurred to read; it is marked as illegible. The German words in the diagram and in the tense paragraphs are printed in black letter and are marked with bl. The diagram's pronoun column and "werden." are set as a separate brace group. The "f 4" at the foot is the gathering signature. The page has no catchword.
